Message:
The fairies were my only
light in the darkness...
and they’d heal each and
every one of my wounds...

When I showed my fairies
to that lady, Guinevere,
she couldn’t believe her eyes.

“You’re able to
control them so easily...
Myrlennia, you’re incredible...!”

“I-I’ve been playing with
these fairies ever since
I was little...
so really, this is all I’ve got...

But, being able to do that’s
just creepy, isn’t it...?”

“I see...
You’ve had such a gift all along,
but no one’s ever seen
your potential, have they?”

“Myrlennia, you really do
have a gift. And no, it’s not
creepy or weird in the slightest.
With your gift, you can achieve
anything you put your mind to.

Your parents couldn’t see that,
but I’ll tell you just
how amazing you are!”

Saying that,
Guinevere pulled me
into a warm hug...

“...I-I’d always been told...
that I’m completely useless,
that I can’t do anything right...

I was only ever yelled at...
that I was better off dead...
over and over again...!”

“I know, let it out.
You’re okay.
I won’t let anyone
scold you ever again.”

That day, I cried and cried
for what felt like forever,
all while gently nestled
in Guinevere’s arms.
